title: The Nameless Grave
narrative_reason: There is a grave on the ash steps with no name on it, and the stone is older than the village that buried whoever is in it.
objectives: Examine the unmarked grave on the ash steps
Recover the buried name plaque from the collapsed shrine
Speak the name where the Borrowed Face can hear it
journal_record: Eleven years without a name is long enough to forget you ever had one. It took three words to give it back.
